name: industrial-troubleshooting-platform
description: Local-first industrial troubleshooting and maintenance intelligence platform (Phase 1: infrastructure foundation)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,ai,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:ai" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @itp/backend && npm run build --workspace @itp/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @itp/backend && npm run test --workspace @itp/frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @itp/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @itp/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @itp/frontend
scripts.lint:ai: cd ai-service && "$(test -x .venv/bin/ruff && echo .venv/bin/ruff || echo ruff)" check .
scripts.docker:config: docker compose config --quiet && echo 'docker-compose.yml is valid'
